from datetime import datetime
import pytz
from dateutil.parser import parse

def task_func(date_str, tz_str):
    tz = pytz.timezone(tz_str)
    dt = parse(date_str)

    if dt.tzinfo is None:
        dt = tz.localize(dt)
    else:
        dt = dt.astimezone(tz)

    next_year_start_naive = datetime(dt.year + 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    next_year_start = tz.localize(next_year_start_naive)

    return int((next_year_start - dt).total_seconds())
